split_rule: Under 30: use all rows and skip the test split
test_evaluation_status: Not available under the assignment's under-30 exception

elbow_selection.method: Largest gap below the endpoint chord on normalized training SSE; inspect the elbow visually.
elbow_selection.warning: Several elbow candidates are close; k is a descriptive design choice, not a clinically validated number of risk levels.

metric_meaning: Distances are in the five-coordinate encoded/scaled space. SSE reduction is not medical accuracy, risk reduction, quality-of-life improvement, or evidence of held-out performance.
retinal_summary_meaning: Post-fit, unweighted descriptive counts of existing findings. These are not future-risk estimates or a held-out validation set.
